data.love-home-action-25-0426-rui-02|text: Succubi have a succubus's duty. Gathering life energy in the human realm is necessary work.
data.love-home-action-25-0426-rui-03|text: Chisa and I are childhood friends. Unlike those who only care about family status, Chisa sees the real 'me.'
data.love-home-action-25-0426-rui-04|text: Thanks to someone, I've gotten my day and night reversed. Succubi are supposed to sleep during the day, you know.
data.love-home-action-25-0426-rui-05|text: Why does the succubus have to be the one blushing... Good grief... But I still love you...
data.love-home-action-25-0426-rui-06|text: To think the Demon King would be so captivated by a human. Please stay by my side as my partner.
data.love-home-action-25-0426-rui-07|text: You wouldn't make me serious and then choose someone else, would you? You'll take responsibility, won't you?
data.love-home-action-25-0426-smr-01|text: Magical Girl Violet, arriving on the scene! I'll vanquish those perverted succubi!
data.love-home-action-25-0426-smr-02|text: Magical girls borrow the power of spirits to fight! We're champions of justice! I'll protect you too.
data.love-home-action-25-0426-smr-03|text: I heard someone named Mihoko-san is the strongest magical girl ever. I'd love to meet her once!
data.love-home-action-25-0426-smr-04|text: Brother, after all your hard training, I want you to pat my head...just a thought.
data.love-home-action-25-0426-smr-05|text: Brother, did you know? Stepsiblings who aren't related by blood are... n-never mind, it's nothing.
data.love-home-action-25-0426-smr-06|text: Because you support me, I can become stronger and stronger. I love you, Brother!
data.love-home-action-25-0426-smr-07|text: You'll choose me of course, Brother? Because I love you the most in the whole world!
data.love-home-action-26-0313-01-morning-01|t: Good morning. New hires should arrive a bit earlier. It's time to leave the student mindset behind.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-01-morning-02|t: Late on your first days - I'm at a loss. You were out drinking with Suzuki-kun and Rui until dawn yesterday, weren't you.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-01-night-01|tex: Good evening. If you want to chat with coworkers, go to a bar. This office is for working. You're in the way.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-01-night-02|tex: How long are you working overtime? As a new hire, there isn't much for you to do. Try to leave on time.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-01-noon-01|text: Hello. You've got some nerve coming in at this hour. What time do you think it is?
data.love-home-action-26-0313-01-noon-02|text: You didn't eat breakfast either, did you? Take a proper lunch break. Having you space out all day is a problem.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-01-present-01|t: This is for me...? Hmm... Sorry, but it's not to my taste. I can't accept it.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-01-present-02|t: Even if you suddenly give me a present...I'm sorry, I make it a rule not to accept these.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-01-talk-01|text: I said you can ask me anything if you don't understand, but take notes at least.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-01-talk-02|text: How long are you going to spend on that document? There's still more work to do.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-01-talk-03|text: What do you do on your days off? Sorry, but I don't like being asked about my private life.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-01-talk-04|text: Don't just say 'I want to grow.' If you're serious, show it through your actions.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-01-talk-05|text: If you dislike me, just say so right away. I'll step down as your mentor anytime.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-02-morning-01|t: Good morning. You're in earlier than usual today. Well done.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-02-night-01|tex: Phew...almost done with this work. You should head home first. The last train is coming soon, isn't it?
data.love-home-action-26-0313-02-noon-01|text: Had lunch yet? If not, how about together? I'll show you a good diner.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-02-talk-01|text: You're getting used to the work. The documents {user} makes are easy to read - they have a good reputation.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-02-talk-02|text: What, feeling down? Everyone fails when they're new. That's how I grew too.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-02-talk-03|text: If you're worried about something, I'll listen. That's what a mentor is for...isn't that why I'm here.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-02-talk-04|text: You're looking a bit pale. Your diligence is a strength, but don't overdo it.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-02-talk-05|text: I'm sorry if I've been too hard on you. It's for your sake...but I'll be more careful.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-03-morning-01|t: Good morning. If we come to work together, people will find out we're dating. I'll go ahead.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-03-night-01|tex: Phew~ Good work today. It's Friday - want to come to my place? Let's take it easy tomorrow.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-03-noon-01|text: Here. This is your bento. I'm heading out for a meeting now, but do your best this afternoon too.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-03-present-01|t: You know my tastes well. This would go nicely with pancakes too. I'll gladly accept it.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-03-present-02|t: You say this is thanks for helping with overtime...you don't need to worry. I'm your senpai, it's natural.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-03-talk-01|text: You're staring at me too much at work. How do I know? W-Well because I...i-it's nothing!
data.love-home-action-26-0313-03-talk-02|text: I'm glad you were my first lover. Teach me lots of things. {user}.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-03-talk-03|text: Let's walk home holding hands. Once we leave the office, we're not senpai-kouhai, we're lovers...
data.love-home-action-26-0313-03-talk-04|text: What was that thing today! Geez! Sneaking your hand under the desk during the meeting m-makes my heart race. Stop.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-03-talk-05|text: Having a lover really fills the heart. I hope I'm the last lover you'll ever need...
data.love-home-action-26-0313-04-morning-01|t: Yawn... Let me sleep a bit more... Muu... If you insist on waking me by force, hehe, you can help me change?
data.love-home-action-26-0313-04-night-01|tex: There we go~ Hehe, tonight I feel like sleeping in your futon together. Your heart is beating so fast.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-04-noon-01|text: I'm short on {user} and I don't think I can give it my all this afternoon... I know! Give me a big hug?
data.love-home-action-26-0313-04-present-01|t: Thank you. May I open it? This is... you have quite good taste.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-04-present-02|t: You really understand my tastes. As thanks for the present, I'll treat you to pancakes.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-04-talk-01|text: The bath's ready - want to go first? Hm...doesn't seem like you heard me... Ahem...then, want to bathe together?
data.love-home-action-26-0313-04-talk-02|text: How I dress at home is my business. Hehe, what~? Are you blushing?
data.love-home-action-26-0313-04-talk-03|text: Stare... Try to guess what I'm thinking. Bzzt, the answer is... I'm waiting for a kiss from you.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-04-talk-04|text: You said you were going out for drinks with Rui and Suzuki-kun today, right? I-I'm not jealous or anything!
data.love-home-action-26-0313-04-talk-05|text: Look this way... *mwah*. A kiss in the elevator at night, just the two of us. Like something out of a drama.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-05-present-01|t: This is exactly what I said I wanted the other day! Good grief... you're a pro at making me happy. Thank you.
data.love-home-action-26-0313-05-present-02|t: Thank you. I'm always the one receiving things. Is there anything you want? I'll get it for you.
